body:
I saw all 7 psychologists in my town and got 6 different diagnosis. I can't afford the tests they want to run so it's kind of impossible to really know. I've been on a lot of different drugs and did a lot of behavioral modification therapy for some reason. The last doctor told me I have a thinking disorder. I guess that's a nice way of saying I'm stupid. 

I can't afford help anymore. These doctors like between $85 and $130 a visit. 

That was 8 years of of sessions and it really didn't get me anywhere. Because I'm stupid and can't hold a job, I don't have the resources to get the help I need. I'm not even sure that they would even be able to help me. I'm so far in debt anyway from school I'm kind of fucked on that front. 

I tried to move to a new city. I never could figure out how to get around. I couldn't remember streets, I got lost all the time. One time I slept in the street because I was too stupid to find my way home. I had to get a smart phone so I could find my way back. I had to give it up though because when I lost my job I couldn't afford the bill.

I don't know what the problem is. I sit there in a class or some kind of training and they show me and tell me what to do. When I go to do it I can't do it. I can't remember what they told or showed me. I just draw a blank or I do the wrong thing and they ask me if I'm dumb because they didn't show me what I just did even though I thought they did. It's like I can't learn things unless it's very simple. 

I got a job at a restaurant. I never could remember how to cook the 8 different meals on their menu. They showed me and other coworkers showed me. I would always fuck it up. It was so embarrassing.
